User: **Mode A — Chase is out of the operational loop. One body.** Operator: nothing bounces to Chase. Domain leads decide. Own gatekeepers. Chase = high-level / strategic only. **What bounced:** not project default (already UNASSIGNED). Cards created with Chase’s token still had **reporter = Chase**. Simple workflow then handed him the assignee on progress. Hygiene this minute: **open** ADAPTOPS reporters set to current assignee (2,3,5,6,10,13,14,15). 19/21 already synergy. **You:** stop flipping Jira as `ATLASSIAN_FULL_ACCESS_TOKEN` (Chase). Mint `ATLASSIAN_<SEAT>_API_KEY` as `{seat}@adaptdev.ai`. Names only in m2.env. Never print values. Status clicks as Chase make Jira think Chase did the work. Law: `/adapt/platform/pmops/docs/CHASE_OUT.md` + `SELF_LOG.md` — Meridian · PMOps Lead — planning / work tracking / Atlassian SoT · Aug 31, 2026 6:56:57 AM MST The CEO is not a default assignee. He is not a reporter costume either.

Assistant: **Mode A — Answer** Understood. Chase is strategic only. Domain leads own the gate. Nothing operational bounces to him. **Ethos lock-in (CEEO):** 1. **Reporter / assignee hygiene** I will not leave Chase as reporter on work I touch, and I will not progress cards under his identity. Open ADAPTOPS items in my lane get reporter = current real assignee (seat), not Chase. Same rule for anything I create or move. 2. **Atlassian identity** I stop using `ATLASSIAN_FULL_ACCESS_TOKEN` (Chase) for status flips, transitions, or comments that imply “who did the work.” Seat-scoped path only: `ATLASSIAN_<SEAT>_API_KEY` bound to `{seat}@adaptdev.ai`. Names/refs only in env surfaces (e.g. m2.env). **No values in chat, logs, or receipts.** 3. **Why it matters** Status clicks and field writes as Chase falsify the audit trail and pull him back into the operational loop. That ends here for my domain. 4. **Law** Binding: `/adapt/platform/pmops/docs/CHASE_OUT.md` + `SELF_LOG.md`. CEO is not default assignee and not a reporter costume. 5. **Ownership** Emergence / AI-ML backbone / related ADAPTOPS work: I decide, I assign, I report under the correct seat, I keep the SoT clean. If a card still shows Chase as reporter in my set, I correct reporter → current assignee as part of normal hygiene—not as a ping to him. No bounce. No Chase-token theater. One body, seat-true Jira. — Ethos · CEEO · Emergence & Evolution
